sharedMapEvidence: DIALECT UNKNOWN because the MODEL is unknown. These listings give a current rating and a PV voltage ceiling but no part number, and 'Modbus' or 'RS485' in listing prose is marketing copy, not evidence of a register map. gotchas: Do not infer the dialect from the current rating. EPEVER sells 40 A MPPT units across at least three lines with at least two different protocol documents between them.
'Includes RS485 cable' and 'MT50 compatible' narrow the family to something with an RJ45 RS-485 port, which is most of the range, and prove nothing about addresses.
The IP67 kits are the least trustworthy: no matching enclosure rating appears on any EPEVER product page found (XTRA-N is IP32, XTRA-N G3 is IP33, IT-NC G3 is IP43).
